subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: (a) ⎯⎯ a student learns his lessons properly, an examination is tough for him. (b) ⎯⎯ if he takes a proper preparation, the examination is easy to him. The night before an examination is (c) ⎯⎯ not joyous. (d) ⎯⎯, it is something like a bad dream. (e) ⎯⎯ a student reads properly, sometimes the fear of examinations haunts him.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) Unless (b) But (c) usually/ always (d) Rather (e) Though
